summary_en: Morozoff will acquire up to 74,000 shares (0.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥109.74 million through a ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange block trade on September 15, 2026, at the closing price of ¥1,483 per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Exchange Trade Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On September 14, 2026, Morozoff's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock through an off-exchange block trade transaction using ToSTNeT-3. The company will purchase up to 74,000 shares, representing 0.4% of outstanding shares (calculated from the 20,094,053 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of July 31, 2026), for a maximum total of ¥109.74 million. The purchase will be executed on September 15, 2026, at the closing price of ¥1,483 per share (including final special quotation values) announced on September 14, 2026. The transaction will occur during the ToSTNeT-3 trading window from 8:45 a.m. at the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the order valid only for that trading session. Results will be disclosed immediately after the trading session closes. The company stated the purpose of this buyback is to conduct flexible capital management in response to changing business circumstances.
